verdict.rationale: AutoGen's evidence shows only conversational routing that loosely resembles event-driven rules: Swarm agents hand off control via HandoffMessage, SelectorGroupChat uses a customizable selector to pick the next speaker after each message, and GraphFlow runs agents along a directed graph. AutoGen Studio can also expose teams as endpoints that external callers could invoke. None of this is documented as user-defined event→action rules, so support is glancing. Missing for 10: an explicit rule/trigger definition mechanism, external event sources (webhooks, schedules, file or system events), conditional edge or rule documentation, and hands-on corroboration.
